coverage_gaps.Claude Blog: The final-hour page was reachable and showed day-level dates through October 19. Date extraction found one window-day entry, but a reachable page and day-level matching do not establish complete coverage of the final hour.
coverage_gaps.Google AI Blog: The configured 20-entry feed was last dated October 13 and yielded no window entries. Upstream category-page checks found two additional window articles by opening their publication metadata; bodies were not read in that collection step. The final-hour feed remained stale, so it cannot establish no further updates. Selected articles were reviewed separately.
coverage_gaps.Google DeepMind: The final-hour response could not be parsed as a valid feed. Earlier records are retained; the final hour is not fully covered.
coverage_gaps.Microsoft AI: The configured URL redirected to Source AI, whose static and rendered lists lacked dates; its old feed returned HTTP 410. Alternative topic and site-wide feeds yielded two candidates but do not establish complete coverage of the configured entry point. The selected October 19 agent article was read in full in a browser; the configured list and final hour remain incomplete.
coverage_gaps.Qwen: The configured GitHub blog remains dated in 2025 and cannot establish no current updates. Only the first screen of the current research site was rendered, without pagination; stale page-configuration records and empty retrieval were inconclusive. Supplemental model creation times and repository pushes are not announcement or release dates. Final-hour date matching against the old blog did not close this gap.
coverage_gaps.通义实验室: The configured homepage was a platform/navigation page without dated news cards. Linked news cards and rendered changelog entries preceded the window; page-modification metadata was not treated as news publication time. Final-hour day-level dates do not establish complete coverage.
coverage_gaps.DeepSeek: API, official news, and harness entry points were checked upstream. October 17 change-log sections and repository prereleases were retained as discovery records, with commits and rendering timestamps distinguished from announcements. Browser follow-up confirmed October 17 as the latest change-log date; other configured entry points were not fully checked for the final hour.
coverage_gaps.月之暗面 Moonshot: Homepage and blog dates preceded the window; blog bodies were not individually read during collection. Final-hour access and day-level date extraction did not establish complete update coverage.
coverage_gaps.智谱 Z.ai: News and research entry points showed older dates. Bodies were not read in collection, and model-navigation dates were not treated as publication dates. Final-hour matching did not establish complete coverage.
coverage_gaps.阶跃星辰 StepFun: The rendered homepage announced available weights but provided no dated news stream. Supplementary repository and model timestamps do not establish publication dates; repository commits were not individually reviewed as announcements. The final-hour page had no extractable dates, so update coverage remains partial.
coverage_gaps.Mistral: An alternative same-site RSS feed contained older dated entries, but configured news cards had unreliable title/date pairing. Bodies were not read. Final-hour page dates do not independently establish full coverage.
coverage_gaps.European Commission Digital Strategy: Upstream title/date matching retained discovery candidates from a list that also includes non-AI news; bodies were not read. Final-hour day-level date extraction does not establish complete window coverage.
coverage_gaps.UNESCO AI: Upstream article cards yielded one window candidate using publication epochs; a conflicting data-date field and unrelated event dates were not used as publication times. Bodies were not read. Final-hour day-level matching did not establish complete coverage.
coverage_gaps.OECD.AI: Upstream embedded date_gmt records yielded sixteen deduplicated Wonk articles, with the latest dated October 12. Other page date-like values were not treated as article dates, and bodies were not read. Final-hour page dates alone do not establish complete coverage.
coverage_gaps.arXiv cs.AI / cs.LG / cs.CL: The API’s latest visible first-submission time preceded the upstream window. Later submissions would only appear after the next announcement; this visibility boundary does not establish that no new papers exist. Submission and announcement times were kept separate. Abstracts were not saved in collection and full texts were not read; final-hour API access did not remove this boundary.
coverage_gaps.OpenReview: The homepage and venue directory were checked, but announcements and lists of open venues do not establish new submissions within the window. Submissions were not searched venue by venue by time.
coverage_gaps.国家网信办·网信发布（AI 相关）: The first news-list page showed dates before the window. Non-AI headlines were retained as exclusions; article bodies were not opened. Final-hour date matching does not establish complete coverage.
coverage_gaps.字节跳动 Seed·博客与论文: Research and blog sections showed older dates. Recommended content was not treated as a complete update stream, and bodies were not read in collection. Browser follow-up checked the research list and selected blog collections, but not every configured entry point.
coverage_gaps.MiniMax·News & Updates: Upstream rendered news cards were dated October 13 or earlier, and article bodies were not read. The final-hour render showed only the page framework, leaving final-hour coverage unverified.
coverage_gaps.TechCrunch: Upstream AI-category pages retained thirteen window records and excluded event/ticket promotions; collection did not read article bodies. Final-hour day-level matching found five window-day entries but did not establish precise publication boundaries or complete coverage. Adopted article texts were reviewed separately.
coverage_gaps.Ars Technica: Upstream list timestamps yielded four window entries, with bodies unread and original versus syndicated status not yet determined. Final-hour access returned HTTP 403, leaving the final-hour list unverified.
coverage_gaps.MIT Technology Review: Upstream topic-page and feed checks retained three window candidates. A separately dated roundtable article was excluded as earlier than the upstream window; collection did not read bodies. A subscription overlay obstructed the final-hour topic list; individual readable articles did not establish complete list coverage.
coverage_gaps.404 Media: Upstream homepage and pagination checks retained eight window-day records, without reading bodies or deleting non-AI entries from discovery. Final-hour matching found five day-level entries, but this does not establish precise boundaries or complete coverage.
